description: Recall-MCP golden set: 50 queries with expected memory ids. The eval test seeds evals/corpus.json verbatim into a fresh SQLite store with the default HashEmbedder, runs each query through hybrid recall with k=5, and gates hit-rate@5 (fraction of queries whose expected memory appears in the top 5) at >= 0.85.
